concept.title: Starter presets and CIS layers
concept.shortdesc: Starter presets and CIS layers help create an initial profile before manual review and editing.

conbody.p: A starter preset gives a profile an initial purpose, such as corporate, classroom, or security-oriented use. A CIS layer adds BPM's mapped security baseline choices where BPM supports them.
Layered sources remain visible in All Settings so you can distinguish baseline, CIS, imported, manual, and raw values. Some CIS-related items require manual review instead of automatic acceptance.
BPM documentation describes BPM mappings and workflow behavior. It does not claim CIS certification or endorsement.
